name: CCA 321 机长心脏骤停失能 PCR ILS区域非空

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 321, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 10100 meters, squawking 3120, your captain suffered from cardiac arrest and became incapacitated, make a Distress call with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 321，从 Beijing 到 Guangzhou，保持 10100 米，应答机 3120，你的机长心脏骤停并失能，向广州管制发出遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Guangzhou Control, CCA321, maintaining 10100 meters, squawking 3120, our captain suffered from cardiac arrest and became incapacitated.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，广州管制，CCA321，保持 10100 米，应答机 3120，我们的机长心脏骤停并失能。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 321, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, roger MAYDAY, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller to stand by and you are checking if there is a doctor on board.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 321，广州管制，雷达识别，收到 MAYDAY，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员稍等，你正在查看机上是否有医生。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, we are checking if there is a doctor on board, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，我们正在查看机上是否有医生，CCA321。

cards.audioText: B: The purser found a doctor on board and offered CPR procedures to revive the captain, but the captain is having difficulty in breathing, inform Guangzhou Control about the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 乘务长在机上找到一名医生，并进行 CPR 试图抢救机长，但机长呼吸困难，向广州管制通报情况。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, the purser found a doctor on board and offered CPR procedures to revive the captain, but the captain is having difficulty in breathing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA321，乘务长在机上找到一名医生并进行 CPR 试图抢救机长，但机长呼吸困难。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 321, when able, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller that you'd like to divert to Wuhan and you need physician and first aid upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 321，可以时说明意图。
B: 告诉管制员你想改航 Wuhan，并且着陆时需要医生和急救。
cards.referenceText: Request divert to Wuhan and request a physician and first aid upon landing, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求改航 Wuhan，并请求着陆时提供医生和急救，CCA321。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 321, roger, turn right, direct to Zulu Foxtrot, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，收到，右转，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，下降并保持 6000 米，联系武汉进近119.35。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, 119.35, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，119.35，CCA321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over Zulu Foxtrot, maintaining 6000 meters, inform your situation to Wuhan Approach and request priority landing and medical services.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 Zulu Foxtrot 上空，保持 6000 米，向武汉进近说明情况并请求优先着陆和医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CCA321, over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, our captain got incapacitated, he is having difficulty in breathing, request priority landing and medical services.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，CCA321，过 ZF，保持 6000 米，我们的机长失能，他呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 321, follow Zulu Foxtrot 02 Alpha arrival, descend to 4200 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 02 Alpha 进场，下降到 4200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF 02A arrival, descend to 4200 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF 02A 进场，下降到 4200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近，CCA321。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 321, descend to 2400 meters, turn right heading 350, reduce speed to 240 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，下降到 2400 米，右转航向 350，减速到 240 节。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2400 meters, turn right heading 350, reduce speed to 240 knots, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 2400 米，右转航向 350，减速到 240 节，CCA321。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 321, descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，下降到 900 米，右转航向 330，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, report established, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900 米，右转航向 330，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA321, established on ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA321，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 321, continue approach runway 36R, surface wind 350 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，继续进近跑道 36R，地面风 350 度，3 米/秒。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 321, runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 340 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，跑道 36R，可以着陆，地面风 340 度，3 米/秒。

cards.audioText: B: During final approach, you find the ILS area is not clear and you are going around, inform Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，你发现 ILS 区域未净空，正在复飞，通知 武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA321, ILS area is not clear, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA321，ILS 区域未净空，复飞。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 321, my apologies for that, follow the standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，对此表示歉意，执行标准复飞程序，爬升到 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.35。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1500 meters, 119.35, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，爬升到 1500 米，119.35，CCA321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have vacated the runway 36R, tell the controller you need a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已脱离跑道 36R，告诉管制员你需要引导车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA321, runway 36R vacated, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA321，已脱离跑道 36R，请求引导车。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 321, hold position, the follow-me car is on the way for you.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 321，原地等待，引导车正在前往你处。
B: 告诉管制员你已看到引导车。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, follow-me car in sight, CCA321.

cards.audioText: C: Air China 321, follow the follow-me car to gate 557 via taxiway Tango 4 and Delta.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 321，跟随引导车经滑行道 Tango 4 和 Delta 到 557 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Follow the follow-me car to gate 557 via taxiway T4 and D, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随引导车经滑行道 T4 和 D 到 557 号登机口，CCA321。
